name: ESO 255-IG007 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 255-IG007, a quartet of interacting galaxies, seen by Hubble.
label: eso255ig007-hubble
story: Three or four galaxies are tangled together here in one arc-shaped structure, and what looks like a single galaxy at its top is really two. Collisions like this can funnel gas and dust inward and set off bursts of star formation.

claims.text: ESO 255-7 is a quartet of interacting galaxies
Three or four galaxies share an arc-like structure
The upper part looks like one galaxy but is two
ESO 255-IG007 is the same object as ESO 255-7 and AM 0626-470
Interactions can trigger bursts of star formation, funneling gas and dust inward
ESO 255-IG007 is a target of an ACS survey of luminous infrared galaxies
